about: A candidate playbook for ab-run (deck@variant) and runner/ab.py --data. Only the playbook object is read; the deck's data stays in its own file.

playbook.notes: Version 3 (2026-11-13), for goldfish; answers left to Forge. Audit (12 stock goldfish games, seeds 25002-25013): kill turn 12.75, 52% of the mana unspent, Mirko cast on own turn 6 to 7 in four games and never in one, Sinister Starfish tapped on 1 of its 15 turns, Port of Karfell, Lazav and Enhanced Surveillance never used, Mission Briefing flagged never-cast. RULES: 1 mana rocks first. 2 Mirko at once (the commander's end-step reanimation needs him out and growing). 3 the surveil engine: Whispering Snitch (drain per surveil turn), Sinister Starfish, Case of the Shifting Visage (upkeep surveil, copies creatures once solved), Dimir Spybug, Enhanced Surveillance. 4 Phyrexian Arena while the library is deep. 5 tap Sinister Starfish every turn (surveil grows Mirko, Spybug, Phantasm and fills the graveyard Mirko returns from). 6 Mission Briefing (AI:RemoveDeck:All). 7 Rise of the Dark Realms whenever affordable. 8 creatures dearest first (the draft's order). 9 Disinformation Campaign after the creatures: in version 2 it sat with the engine and looped on every surveil, 42 casts on 12 games and two games a turn slower. 10 cheap card draw with a library guard. 11 Doom Whisperer's surveil while life >= 20. 12 Tocasia's Dig Site after combat. 13 Port of Karfell after combat with eight lands (never fired in tuning). TRIGGERS: Mirko's end-step return always; Master of Death's return at life >= 10; Marvo's free cast; Copy Catchers' {1}{U} copy with four mana spare and a deep library (64 to 74 copies paid in 12 games: it is what makes the board wide). Tuning on the audit seeds: version 1 1.67 turns faster than stock (95% +1.06 to +2.27, 10 faster, 2 same); version 2 (Disinformation in the engine rule, Port of Karfell added) 0.17 slower than version 1.
